additional_info.subject: Error description
additional_info.body:
Hi Team,
Last week we performed a field intervention because Outlet 2 was not initiating charging. We diagnosed QA13/14 contactor failure, replaced the contactors, and verified the fix with a successful charging session on site.
However, reviewing the most recent data, we now see that charging attempts on both outlets start and then terminate shortly after. As you can see in the attached data, there have been numerous failed attempts within the last 24 hours.
Could you please perform a detailed root-cause analysis and advise next steps?
